subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain bounded media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, or should those attachments remain unavailable?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes what unmentioned group attachments are retained and later exposed to model context.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep unmentioned media unavailable
options.body: Treat unmentioned Telegram group media as intentionally unavailable to later turns and document that this history stores only text placeholders.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Hold implementation until a maintainer-reviewed live Telegram proof demonstrates the failure and proposed privacy limits.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram group-history policy work makes this the closest owner signal for the channel behavior decision.
